title: Hyperbridge — TokenGateway Forged-Proof Admin Takeover & Fake Mint (Ethereum)
loss_raw: **~$2,500,000** (revised per Hyperbridge post-mortem; initial reports cited ~$237K extracted ETH, but multi-chain forensic audit 3 days post-incident confirmed ~$2.5M total); ~1 billion bridged DOT forged (theoretical ~$1.17B at mid-market, but pool liquidity was too thin to monetize)
root_cause: HandlerV1 accepts a forged ISMP state proof; TokenGateway.onAccept() executes a `ChangeAssetAdmin` action that transfers admin / minter role to the attacker, who then mints arbitrary bridged ERC20s
steps: → attacker becomes admin/minter of bridged ERC20
2 | 0x240aeb9a…401109 | 24,868,295 | **First forgery mint** | 1,000,000,000 bridged DOT minted → Uniswap V4 PoolManager

3 | 0xb28ab952…f8ac09 | 24,868,422 | **Multi-token forgery** | Mints 1B of token `0x6A9143…55155` and 1B of `0x64CBd3…5f01`; swaps chunks for USDC / WETH on V3 pools; sinks ~1e27 of `0x6A91…` to attacker EOA
4 | 0xb80c7d4c…443c3a | 24,868,450 | Mint + V4 swap | 10,000 DOT → PoolManager → 0.00677 WETH back to recipient
6 | 0x6f1efcde…0a0808 | 24,868,577 | DAI/WETH swap + mint | 0.493 DAI ↔ 0.000225 WETH on Uniswap V3 DAI/WETH, then 712,403 DOT minted → PoolManager
